### Bug Fixes

This release adds `@plan_parsing` to sp_QuickieStore. With `@plan_parsing = 1`, the procedure reads the plans in Query Store and reports plan findings. Examples are eager index spools, missing indexes and predicates that cannot use a seek. sp_QuickieStore with `@get_all_databases = 1` no longer stops when one database is unreadable. A round of reviews fixed smaller problems in nine procedures and in the helper scripts.
- sp_QuickieStore: with `@get_all_databases = 1`, the procedure skips a database that the

This release makes the averages in sp_QuickieStore and sp_QueryReproBuilder match Query Store, and it adds a new `@top` parameter to sp_QueryReproBuilder. sp_IndexCleanup no longer disables an index that backs a foreign key, and it judges unused indexes on each database's own usage window. Two patch sets (164 patches, with review fixes) corrected smaller problems in nine procedures and made sp_QuickieStore, sp_QueryReproBuilder and sp_HealthParser faster.
- sp_HumanEvents: the name of a one-shot session now

- On SQL Server 2022 and later, the procedure removes PSP parent queries after their variants. It skips a parent while its variants are still in Query Store. (#883, #884)
- New `@compact_tables`. After the removal, it compacts each index on Query Store's internal tables with `DBCC INDEXDEFRAG`, and it reports each size before and after. It also runs on a READ_ONLY Query Store, where it skips the removal. (#885, #886)
- sp_QuickieCache: `@find_duplicate_plans` returns one row for each query hash in each data

- The summary distinguishes "no waits" from "wait stats capture is off" instead of silently dropping the column. Only 1 of those 11 databases had capture on, and the silent omission fooled the harness that found the rest of this list.

- Dialogs with long button labels (like switching MariaDB versions) wrap their buttons inside the window instead of past its edge (#222).

- PHP 8.6.0 on Windows and macOS, with its extensions (Services → PHP → Versions). On Windows, php.net has no PECL builds for 8.6 yet, so EnvKit builds 29 of them itself (redis, xdebug, apcu, imagick, sqlsrv, igbinary, grpc and more); mongodb comes from php.net. PHP 8.5 stays the default. Not available for 8.6 yet: swoole, ionCube and SourceGuardian. On a Windows PC whose Visual C++ runtime is too old for 8.6, it is installed but not made the default, and the app says how to fix it.
- MySQL/MariaDB: upd

- Databases: large imports no longer stop with "Lost connection to MySQL server". Creating a database whose name is taken says so plainly.
- PostgreSQL asking for a password now says why: another PostgreSQL on the same port, or a changed pg_hba.conf.
- New: Databases → a database → ⋯ → ER diagram can also open in your browser.

- New: Databases → a MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL database → ⋯ → ER diagram. EnvKit reads the tables (no data) from its own server and draws them in the app; nothing leaves your machine. The diagram tool is SQL to ER Diagram (MIT) by Royal Bhati and Masry2001.

- After switching from classic EnvKit, your databases keep running from the folder classic used. If two copies both hold data, EnvKit asks instead of picking the older one: it names both folders and starts that database only once you choose (#207).
- Windows: PostgreSQL no longer opens console windows (its server, pg_ctl and the tools all run hidden).

- Windows: services the classic EnvKit left running as administrator (nginx, PHP, MySQL, Postgres…) no longer block the new app's start with no explanation. EnvKit names them and the port they hold, and Stop on the Dashboard's port warning ends them after one Windows prompt. Updating over the new app also stops them.
- phpMyAdmin, pgAdmin and the other database tools say why they aren't running when their server was never started, instead of just "stopped".

## The new EnvKit (beta) 0.34.0-beta.4

- With Settings → Performance → Reduce visual effects on (or the system's reduced motion), dialogs no longer flash when they open and close, and the Community menu in the sidebar shows its labels again.
- After an update, EnvKit no longer shows "EnvKit failed to start" while the previous engine is still shutting down: the window waits for the engine, and the message clears by itself once the engine answers.
- Linux: this version is out for Linux too (AppImage, .de
- Windows: no more console windows popping up at startup or on the Databases page.

A fix release for Macs.

- The `envkit` command in the terminal and the login item keep working after the update.
